title: Colloquial Reactions & Exclamations
goal: React naturally in conversation with ¡Qué raro/pena/suerte que! + subjunctive vs ¡Menos mal que! + indicative
grammar: colloquial emotional exclamations with present perfect subjunctive vs menos mal que

items: I can react to recent events with *¡Qué raro / pena / suerte que!* + present perfect subjunctive.
I can contrast those reactions with *¡Menos mal que!* + indicative.
I can use everyday food and reaction vocabulary like *atragantarse*, *merendar*, *el picoteo* and *el guiso*.
